div.div:
Module boundary rule (CLAUDE.md)
A module imports only app.core and another module's service.py; cross-module side effects only via events.
Enforced by tests/test_architecture.py: absolute imports only (relative imports not checked); core may import only modules.registry; every module dir registered. The 'events, not direct calls' half is not machine-checked.
